School wall collapses in Ajmer amid heavy rain, damaging vehicles

A school wall in Ajmer collapsed during heavy rainfall, burying five vehicles under the debris. The driver of one car, who was sleeping inside, narrowly escaped. The incident occurred after vehicles were parked for a fee of 500 rupees. The wall reportedly collapsed like a house of cards.
